subject: Application: Project Engineer (Fixed Term), Infrastructure, Marc Masarate
notes: Portal application via ApplyNow. Cover letter prepared for upload with resume.
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Project Engineer (Fixed Term), Infrastructure role (PSC2222655) advertised on the Parkes Shire Council careers portal, closing 25 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work.

Supporting water and sewer capital projects from planning through to commissioning is the delivery work I want to grow in. I have not yet worked on water or sewer networks in Australia, so I would start as a graduate and learn those systems on the job.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. I would welcome the chance to apply through your portal and discuss the role.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
